messages.author: 2dbe0cb7e083aa80
messages.subject: Executable file - first time user
parts:
Hi everybody,

We are trying to use R-swat with example data available in github. However, we don´t have the executable swat+ file  showed in video of youtube (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UOknxfrzplY). We try to use SWATPlusEditor.exe but we are not sure if this is correct. 

When we go to Parameter sampling tab and click in blue button (Click here to check the input table) , we get the "Error:  Cannot find the selected parameter in the cal_parms.cal file". But in tab General setting we set cal_parms.cal available to the txtinout folder. 

This is the first time we are using r-swat, so our doubts are very simple. 

If we try to run swat this way, we get "task 1 failed" error message. Folders TxtInOut_1 to TxtInOut_4 are generated with files, but if we check the "Open file CurrentSimulationReport.log" option, nothing appears. 

Thanks by any help.
Ligia Batista

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Executable file - first time user
parts:
Hi Ligia

1. The executable SWAT is available in SWAT website (Section 2 of this page https://swatplus.gitbook.io/docs/installation). The one that you mentioned ( SWATPlusEditor.exe) is not an executable of the SWAT model
2. I admit that this could happen (trying to figure out later). This is because the Table is inactive, if you just click to the random cell of this table and type again (or copy paste) the same information to that cell, the table will be updated and there will be no Error message appear.
3. The model is till running so it is busy and I cannot do anything until it finished all simulations, in this case, you just wait until all simulations are finished

Hope this help
